programme.title: The Fierce Wife
programme.desc: An Zhen divorces her husband after his infidelity but faces a pivotal decision four years later - to return to her cheating husband and old life or to embark on a new life with a new love?

programme.title: Inner Senses
programme.desc: Haunted by recurring visions stemming from past traumas, Yan reaches out to psychiatrist Dr Jim to restore her sanity and overcome her troubled past. Yet, as Yan gradually heals, Jim finds himself haunted by the same disturbing images, as his suppressed memories resurface.

programme.title: Our Crazy Adventures
programme.desc: Before graduation, five high school friends - Jia Yi, Kopi, Uncle, Wawa and Ah Di - decide to do something unforgettable together. Chasing dreams, friendship and youthful passion, they take on a seemingly impossible challenge, winning a crucial basketball game that could change their lives and shape their future forever.

programme.title: Mr & Mrs Incredible
programme.desc: Middle-aged and retired superhero couple, Huan (Gazer Man) and Red (Aroma Woman), settles into a contented life in a remote village. They find it hard to contain their powers though, and are bored by the uneventful life. When they hear a world martial arts contest is to be held in their village, both are itching to make their long-awaited comeback!

programme.title: Once Upon A Time In Hong Kong
programme.desc: This is a story of ICAC investigators fighting against rampant corruption in early 1970s' Hong Kong. A police sergeant teams up with a triad boss to make billions of dollars in bribes. As a lawyer joins his friend in ICAC to investigate their collusion and fight against corruption, the battle between the righteous and the wicked has just begun.

programme.title: Band Four
programme.desc: An aspiring singer of an indie band called Band Four reunites with her estranged guitarist father following the death of her mother. Together with her half-sister and her nine-year-old son, the newly reunited family come together to support each other through their love and passion for music.

programme.title: The Wandering Earth II
programme.desc: In this prequel, humans build enormous engines on the Earth's surface to find a new home when the sun is burning out. In the dangerous universe, a group of young people has to step forward once again to fight in the critical battle to save the Earth.

programme.title: The Sparring Partner
programme.desc: Adapted from a sensational 2013 parricide in Hong Kong, a young man partners with his friend to murder and dismember his parents. Pleading not guilty, the defendants play the devil and idiot game, while the defense attorneys turn on each other. Meanwhile, heated debates emerge inside the jury room, where nine jurors grapple with the truth.

programme.title: Dragon Tiger Gate
programme.desc: Adapted from a famous Hong Kong comic, Tiger Wong is ambushed after he unwittingly took the Lousha Plaque but is saved by his brother Dragon Wong. They also befriended Turbo Shek during the fight and the trio forms a brotherhood. To avenge the death of the Dragon Gate masters, they train and vow to defeat Shibumi, the leader of Lousha Clan.

programme.title: The Exodus
programme.desc: A low-ranking cop discovers a group of women, including his superior, Madam Fang and his wife, plotting to eliminate the world of men.

programme.title: Hand Rolled Cigarette
programme.desc: A retired British-Chinese soldier becomes a target in a triad manhunt when he takes in a young South Asian man who carries a bag of stolen drugs. Forced to live together, the two men transcend conflicts and cultural differences to form a beautiful friendship in this poignant tale of loyalty and brotherhood.

programme.title: Dumpling Queen, The
programme.desc: In the 1970s, Zang moves to Hong Kong with her two daughters following a failed marriage. Starting as a dishwasher and odd-job worker, she struggles to survive. With a family dumpling recipe, she sets up a stall at Wan Chai Pier and rises from a street vendor to the city's renowned “Dumpling Queen”.

programme.title: Behind the Shadows
programme.desc: Private detective Ouyang uncovers his wife's betrayal during an investigation. Reeling from the shock, he abandons a missing person case. Soon after, the missing person turns up dead. Inspector Chen suspects a serial killer may be at large. Now drawn back into the case, Ouyang must use his skills to stop the killer before another life is taken.

programme.title: Secret Service of the Imperial Court
programme.desc: Zhao Bu Fan is the sergeant of the government's secret police. Wang is a cruel and ruthless eunuch who takes over the Emperor's ruling power and leads the team of secret agents. After witnessing the atrocities committed by Eunuch Wang, Sergeant Zhao decides to defect but ends up being hunted by his friends, comrades and even his father.

programme.title: Return Of The Crazy Bumpkins
programme.desc: This sequel makes for more bittersweet laughs and heart-wrenching misfortune, as Ah Niu gets out of the jail to find his true love becoming the wife of an abusive husband, and his uncle further exploits his naive nature.

programme.title: Killer Constable
programme.desc: Kuei Chih-hung was famous for his modern day crime thrillers, his horror flicks, and even his comedies. But if the only kung-fu film he ever made was this one, he'd still be spoken of with respect by even the most ardent martial arts movie fan. Many consider this real life martial arts champion Chen Kuan-tai's best performance. As a deeply, even obsessively, dedicated Chief Court Constable, he illuminates the screen with fighting skill and emotional passion. Award winning actor Ku Feng is his equal, playing an especially homicidal robber-chief who thinks nothing of throwing all his men at their relentless pursuer. Lu Tsun and Huang Pei-chi choreograph the many battles featuring such action stalwarts as Pai Piao and Ai Fei.

programme.title: Crazy Shaolin Disciples
programme.desc: The story revolves around three lay disciples of the Shaolin Temple: Fang Shi Yu, Hong Xi Guan, and Hu Hui Qian. Monk Jie instructs them in martial arts, but their frequent competitions with fellow disciple Wu Qing spark rivalries. The once serene Shaolin Temple is plunged into chaos, yet even the abbot cannot help but be amused by their antics.

programme.title: Disco Bumpkins
programme.desc: This musical comedy is about how a young man Fen, along with his buddy Hamburger, finds love and success in the advertising world.

programme.title: Brave Archer And His Mate
programme.desc: Guo Jing and Huang Rong raise the son of his sworn brother Yang Kang and named him Yang Guo. To prevent Yang Guo from taking revenge for his father's death, Huang Rong bans him from learning martial arts. Yang Guo runs away from home in anger and encounters Ouyang Feng, who teaches him the “Toad Stance” and accidentally unveils his true identity…

programme.title: Hong Kong 73
programme.desc: In 1973, the Hong Kong Heng Seng Index hit extraordinary peaks and people from all walks of life go stock market crazy. Meanwhile, Hong Kong's social problems build up without anyone paying attention to what are actually happening to the crazy lives of people, in this mad city that many call home...

programme.title: Wits Of The Brats
programme.desc: Nan Tou Kuan, a spoiled but talented young heir from Guangdong, is sent to Beijing by his mother to find a bride and mature. Along the way, he befriends three rogues: a cardsharp, a ladies' man, and a master thief. Together, they must outwit the sinister Three-Eyed Taoist, who plots to seize the family's fortune.

programme.title: The Three Smiles
programme.desc: A talented scholar, Bo Hu, is attracted by the pretty maid, Qiu Xiang. In order to get close to her and win her love, he disguises as a servant to work in the same household. Qiu Xiang does not believe Bo Hu when he discloses his true identity to her, only falling in love with him when he reveals his talents and with his friends' help.

programme.title: The Naval Commandos
programme.desc: The Chinese Navy is attempting to defend its coastline from a Japanese attack, they send their commando unit led by Cui Hsia into the mainland to enlist help to thwart the Japanese before they attack. The commandos enlist the help of Song San and Shiao Liu to kill the Japanese officers led by Shan Mao and destroy their attacking ships.

programme.title: The Swordmates
programme.desc: Li asks his swordmate Wang to protect his family while he is away, but Wang rapes his wife and even has his convoy attacked. Li escaped but fears his daughter is still in danger, so he asks the nephew of his master to help protect her…

programme.title: The Fighting Fool
programme.desc: Famous Kung Fu Pole master Red Eagle, is kidnapped by a villain one day. His disciple Meng, vows to rescue him. On his way, Meng encounters a greedy but great martial artist who agrees to join him in the rescue. Even though the two have extremely different personalities, they manage to team up and fight the villain in a final showdown.

programme.title: Mist Over Dream Lake
programme.desc: A young girl Chen is sent away by her parents who are going through divorce, to stay with the Chang's. On the Chang's farm, she meets their two sons, the youngest daughter and a young artist, and spends a summer with them that she will never forget.

programme.title: Dirty Ho
programme.desc: Master Wang, who is actually the 11th prince, poses as an antique connoisseur to hide his true identity. When he meets Dirty Ho, a witty con artist, Wang knows he has found the right man to help him untangle a royal succession plot...

programme.title: The Pure and the Evil
programme.desc: Two teen girls, Rose and May, become close friends despite their different social backgrounds. The rich girl May moves to America but returns years later to see Rose, now a beauty queen and bar girl. Rose is immediately attracted to Fang's fiancé and their relationship quickly deteriorates when Rose sets out to pursue him…

programme.title: UFC Fight Night: Allen vs. Duncan - Main
programme.desc: Middleweights man the marquee as UFC returns to the Meta APEX in Las Vegas on Sunday, October 11 as Brendan “All-In” Allen squares off with “CLD” Christian Leroy Duncan. A rankings staple for the last several years, Allen has forced his way into the Top 5 on the strength of a three-fight winning streak over Marvin Vettori, Reinier de Ridder, and Edmen Shahbazyan. Gloucester, England's Duncan has claimed five straight victories heading into his first UFC main event assignment, most recently out-hustling former title challenger Jared Cannonier in July.

programme.title: UFC 332: Silva vs. Wang - Main
programme.desc: UFC returns to Delta Center in Salt Lake City, Utah for UFC 332 headlined by a clash for the vacant UFC women's flyweight title between Natalia Silva and “The Joker” Wang Cong. The No.1 contender Silva enters having won each of her first eight UFC appearances and 14 consecutive contests overall, a run that includes victories over top contender Jasmine Jasudavicius and former UFC champions Jessica Andrade, Alexa Grasso, and Rose Namajunas. Fighting out of Liaoning Province, China, Wang arrives having won four straight and five of six appearances inside the Octagon, most recently defeating Tracy Cortez at UFC 329.

Program ini memberi peluang kepada bakat muda untuk merealisasikan impian mereka menjadi pemain bola sepak terbaik di peringkat kebangsaan dan antarabangsa. Program ini mencungkil bakat bola sepak anak-anak muda berusia bawah 14 tahun dan bawah 16 tahun.

programme.title: Sensasi Bola - 28
programme.desc: Sensasi Bola merupakan satu program bual bicara berdurasi setengah jam bersama pemain bola sepak, selebriti, jurulatih dan peminat sebagai tetamu undangan setiap minggu. Antara topik menarik yang akan dikupas adalah isu mengenai bola sepak tempatan dan antarabangsa, temubual ekslusif bersama lagenda bola sepak, tips kesihatan serta isu semasa yang menjadi perbualan masa kini.

programme.title: UFC Fight Flashback - 1101 - Gaethje vs Holloway
programme.desc: UFC 300 was not only a milestone event for the world's leading MMA organization but featured a highly anticipated bout between Justin Gaethje and Max Holloway as they battled for the “BMF” belt and the title of the “baddest” fighter on the planet. See their fight like never seen before with enhanced replays and angles, new footage, and exclusive audio.

programme.title: UFC Reloaded - UFC 318: Holloway vs Poirier 3
programme.desc: It's a memorable night in New Orleans, Louisiana, when Lafayette native Dustin Poirier makes his final walk to the Octagon, hoping to go three for three against Max Holloway, with the BMF title on the line. This one for the history books and much more on UFC Reloaded

programme.title: UFC Ultimate Knockouts - 1003 - Ultimate Knockouts "Hispanic Heritage Month 2023
programme.desc: UFC Ultimate Knockouts celebrates Hispanic Heritage Month. See Edson Barboza, Polyana Viana, Marlon Vera, and more.

programme.title: UFC Countdown - UFC 315: Muhammad vs Della Maddalena
programme.desc: UFC 315 Countdown takes an inside look at two title fights, as welterweight king Belal Muhammad attempts to defend his crown against Jack Della Maddalena, and flyweight queen Valentina Shevchenko puts her belt on the line against Manon Fiorot.

programme.title: LALIGA HISTORIC MOMENTS - GERARD PIQUE'S RETIREMENT
programme.desc: Barcelona club captain and Spanish national team legend Gerard Pique has called time on his career. This is a whirlwind look back at the illustrious career of a man who has won everything the game has to offer.

programme.title: UFC Fight Night: Allen vs. Duncan - Main
programme.desc: Middleweights man the marquee as UFC returns to the Meta APEX in Las Vegas on Sunday, October 11 as Brendan “All-In” Allen squares off with “CLD” Christian Leroy Duncan. A rankings staple for the last several years, Allen has forced his way into the Top 5 on the strength of a three-fight winning streak over Marvin Vettori, Reinier de Ridder, and Edmen Shahbazyan. Gloucester, England's Duncan has claimed five straight victories heading into his first UFC main event assignment, most recently out-hustling former title challenger Jared Cannonier in July.

programme.desc: Antasya tak sempat mengkhabarkan berita gembira kepada Syarhan apabila tiba-tiba mengalami pendarahan. Syarfan mengamuk dan menuduh Antasya cuba menggugurkan kandungan kerana benci dengan hubungan mereka apabila mendapat tahu kandungan Antasya gugur disebabkan racun. Hubungan mereka kian dingin. Razali hilang dan disyaki diculik oleh Datin Jasmin.

programme.title: Agen Dunia
programme.desc: Citra dan Reza cuba berkahwin tetapi tidak direstui kedua keluarga kerana perbezaan suku Jawa & Sunda. Mereka mengupah “Agen Dunia” Jamal untuk membuang kebencian antara keluarga seterusnya dapat melangsungkan perkahwinan.

programme.title: Isteri Dalam Sangkar
programme.desc: Iskandar nekad untuk melepaskan Aisyah, dia membawa Aisyah ke tempat dia dan Aisyah di nikahkan. Aisyah berdebar menanti apa yang mahu di katakana oleh Iskandar. Iskandar meluahkan segalanyan dan mahu melafazkan cerai terhadap Aisyah. Aisyah merayu supaya lafaz itu tidak diteruskan. Aisyah rebah sebelum lafaz cerai terlafaz. Iskandar mengeraskan hatinya untuk tidak mengasihani Aisyah, dia mahu meninggalkan Aisyah dan membiarkan Aisyah rebah di situ. Kenangan cinta Iskandar terhadap Aisyah muncul semula dan membuatkan Iskandar kembali sedar dan mendapatkan Aisyah. Doktor menasihati Iskandar untuk tidak memberi sebarang tekanan kepada Aisyah jika mahu ingatan Aisyah pulih dan yang penting perlu beri ruang dan juga masa buat Aisyah. Iskandar berasa marah dengan dirinya sendiri atas keputusan yang dilakukan. Iskandar membawa Aisyah berehat di Villa itu. Iskandar memaklumkan hal itu kepada Tengku Maria dan Tengku Maria sangat lega dengan keputusan Iskandar. Dia memaklumkan dia akan membuat semula rancangannya untuk majlis persandingan mereka. Aisyah minta Iskandar membawanya pulang ke kampong semula untuk menjemput keluarga Mak Su Ainin, Ros, dan menziarahi kubur kedua ibu bapanya. Aisyah juga minta Iskandar membawanya bertemu dengan keluarga Rokiah dan keluarga Anim.

programme.desc: Sara menerima lamaran Irfan setelah menyedari keikhlasan cintanya sejak kecil. Airel yang kecewa akur berkahwin dengan Damia demi pilihan keluarga. Namun, perkahwinan tanpa cinta mengundang kesedihan buat Damia apabila Airel lebih mengutamakan tugasnya. Sementara itu, Irfan dan Maisarah bahagia meneruskan pertunangan mereka.

programme.title: Sedingin Cinta Antasya
programme.desc: Datin Jasmin menculik Razali dan memerangkap Hana datang ke gudang. Datin Jasmin mengeluarkan pistol dan cuba menembak mereka di situ. Datin Jamsin rebah ditembak Hana apabila Hana berjaya mendapatkan pistol. Antasya menyangka Syarfan telah menembak ayahnya. Hana memukul kepala Antasya. Antasya rebah.

programme.title: Beheading
programme.desc: Sebuah keluarga menjadi sasaran kemurkaan suatu entiti, memaksa mereka mempersembahkan korban kuno dengan mengahwinkan anak perempuan mereka dengan patung semangat leluhur yang tidak berkepala.

programme.title: The Equalizer S2 EP16
programme.desc: Apabila Aunty Vi merupakan satu-satunya juri dalam perbicaraan pembunuhan yang percaya bahawa defendan tidak bersalah, McCall secara rahsia menyiasat kes itu untuk mencari bukti bahawa naluri Vi adalah betul.

programme.title: Hysteria! EP3

programme.title: Ceroboh
programme.desc: Selepas dunia dilanda makhluk asing yang dikenali sebagai Penunggu Langit—yang mampu mengawal minda manusia—enam rakan berlindung di sebuah bangunan usang. Namun apabila salah seorang daripada mereka terdedah kepada mereka, rasa curiga dan paranoia mula menjangkiti kumpulan itu, membawa ancaman yang lebih membahayakan daripada serangan di luar.

programme.title: Don't Blink
programme.desc: Sepuluh orang tiba di sebuah pusat peranginan pergunungan yang terpencil dan mendapati ia lengang sepenuhnya. Tanpa minyak untuk perjalanan pulang, para pengunjung terpaksa tinggal dan menyiasat misteri di sekitar pondok yang terbengkalai itu.

programme.title: Police Story II
programme.desc: Pegawai polis hebat Hong Kong itu perlu menghentikan sekumpulan pengebom yang melakukan pemerasan, sementara musuh-musuh daripada filem *Police Story* (1985) pula mahu membalas dendam.

programme.title: Siku 12: Langkah Derhaka
programme.desc: Seorang bapa telah merahsiakan ilmu persilatan yang telah lama dipelajari daripada anaknya kerana sejarah hitam yang dilaluinya. Anaknya merupakan peninju Muay Thai dan atas desakan yang bertubi-tubi, bapa akhirnya mewariskan ilmu yang dikenali sebagai 'Jurus Siku 12 Langkah Derhaka' kepada anaknya yang akan bertanding pada pertandingan terbuka Pendang Muay Thai 2021.

programme.title: Highland Tower
programme.desc: Pada Disember 1993, sebuah blok kondominium mewah runtuh selepas hakisan tanah dari lereng bukit bersebelahan. Kira-kira 50 orang terkorban dan kejadian ini sehingga kini menjadi salah satu tragedi paling gelap dan menyedihkan dalam sejarah Malaysia. Dua puluh tahun kemudian, pada 2013, sekumpulan pembuat filem dokumentari menjelajah ke dua blok yang masih berdiri untuk menjalankan ekspedisi memburu hantu. Apa yang mereka temui tidak sesuai untuk mereka yang lemah semangat.

programme.desc: Mengisahkan Syadon, seorang pemuda yang mencintai Mala. Pada suatu hari, Syadon bertemu seorang gadis bernama Pari yang sedang mencari kekasihnya. Semakin hari, Pari semakin suntuk waktu yang Pari ada untuk mengahwini jejaka idamannya dan pulang ke dunia kayangan. Syadon bertanya siapakah Pari yang sebenarnya dan setelah diterangkan, dia sukar mempercayainya. Pari terpaksa membuktikan kata-katanya dengan menunaikan permintaan Syadon.

programme.title: Seri Dewi Malam
programme.desc: Cinta seorang isteri kepada suami yang sangat kuat membuatkannya ingin terus berjuang untuk hidup. Azri menemui jalan untuk berkomunikasi bersama isterinya, Seri yang jatuh koma. Dewi, seorang gadis buta yang memboleh membaca minda memutuskan untuk membantu Azri berhubung dengan Seri. Lama kelamaan, perasaan cinta mula muncul dan Azri harus membuat pilihan yang sukar.

programme.title: Soal Hati
programme.desc: Daniel ialah seorang lelaki playboy kaya yang mempunyai perniagaan yang berjaya. Dia mula berubah setelah jatuh cinta pandang pertama dengan Nurul Ain, seorang gadis kampung yang bekerja sebagai jurujual. Daniel berusaha untuk memikat Nurul Ain dengan berpura-pura menjadi seorang lelaki biasa bernama Ahmad namun akhirnya diketahui oleh Nurul Ain. Dapatkan Daniel memikat hati Nurul Ain kembali?

programme.title: Perempuan
programme.desc: Nita merancang untuk menikahi teman lelakinya, Idris. Berasal dari keluarga yang kaya, Nita merasakan ibunya bersikap seperti seorang majikan kerana kesibukan kedua orang tuanya. Nita menagih kasih sayang kedua ibu bapanya. Ingin bertunang dengan Idris namun ibunya ingin menjodohkan Nita bersama anak Datuk Hamzah.

programme.title: Perjanjian Syaitan
programme.desc: Tambun membunuh Tok Kadim, penghulu di sebuah kampung dan kemudiannya mengatakan bahawa Tok Kadim mati satu kemalangan. Selepas kejadian itu, Tambun dilantik menjadi ketua kampung yang baharu. Pada masa yang sama, Ribut, adik kepada Tambun yang berwajah hodoh ingin membalas dendam kepada Ujang kerana menolak cintanya dan memilih Seri sebagai teman. Ribut bersahabat dengan syaitan yang berjanji untuk menjadikannya seorang perempuan cantik. Sejak itulah Ribut berusaha untuk membalas dendam sehingga berlaku beberapa siri kematian yang penuh misteri.

programme.title: Putera
programme.desc: Putera Hussein, pewaris takhta kerajaan Nusantara yang tidak mahu dijodohkan dengan sepupunya, Puteri Balkis. Ayahanda Putera Hussein memberi tempoh selama 30 hari kepadanya untuk mencari bakal isteri. Putera Hussein menyamar sebagai rakyat biasa dan bertemu dengan seorang gadis bernama Noraini. Mereka berdua jatuh cinta namun percintaan itu mendapat halangan keluarga Noraini.

Dolah melakukan kerja ngeri ini dengan bantuan dua orang kawannya, tetapi pada suatu masa dia telah gagal memenuhi syarat tersebut dan bermacam kejadian telah berlaku selepas itu.

Dalam keadaan kelam kabut itu, seorang demi seorang penerjun melompat keluar dan mendarat di sebuah kawasan hutan. Di sana, mereka diganggu pelbagai peristiwa dan menganggap tempat itu berpuaka. Namun, Kapten Hanafi mengesyaki semua peristiwa itu adalah berpunca daripada perbuatan manusia.

programme.desc: Ali bekerja sebagai jurufoto di syarikat penerbitan majalah jatuh hati kepada Sarah, seorang lulusan Universiti Al-Azhar. Ali panik apabila rakan serumahnya memberitahu keluarga Sarah ingin menjodohkannya dengan seorang ustaz. Untuk memenangi hati Sarah dan keluarganya, Ali terpaksa berbohong dengan mengatakan dia juga merupakan seorang graduan Universiti Al-Azhar. Dalam masa yang sama bos Ali, Dato' Razali Bunari cuba mendedahkan satu skandal yang turut melibatkan bapa Sarah.

Jason tertarik dengan keindahan kampung dan keramahan penduduk di situ, lalu membuat keputusan untuk tinggal sementara di sana. Pertemuan mereka membawa kepada satu kisah menarik yang penuh kejutan dan kemungkinan cinta yang tidak diduga.

programme.title: Tiba-Tiba Kuis
programme.desc: Program kuiz kejutan di tengah keramaian yang menawarkan hadiah wang tunai lumayan. Orang ramai dipilih secara rawak untuk menjawab soalan mudah, sementara reaksi spontan dan kisah menyentuh mereka dirakam bagi menghasilkan hiburan yang menyeronokkan serta penuh makna.

programme.title: Water Games
programme.desc: Sekumpulan peserta bertanding dalam pelbagai cabaran dalam satu permainan air, dengan impian memenangi hadiah utama.

programme.title: Cinta Sedalam Rindu
programme.desc: Aluna menyangka takdirnya hanyalah sebagai anak kepada seorang pembantu rumah yang terpaksa mengorbankan cintanya demi Felicia, anak majikannya. Namun, apabila rahsia dari masa lalunya terbongkar, seluruh hidup mereka berubah sama sekali.

programme.title: Salingka Bumi Minang
programme.desc: Dokumentari separa realiti yang meneroka Minang, sebuah wilayah di Indonesia yang terkenal sebagai Tanah Para Pedagang.

programme.title: Tertawan Hati
programme.desc: Alya dan Alyssa ialah pasangan kembar yang terpisah sejak lahir. Selepas 25 tahun, takdir menemukan mereka semula, dan mereka terkejut melihat wajah yang begitu seiras. Pertemuan itu merapatkan hubungan mereka, namun tanpa disedari pelbagai rahsia dan konflik mula terbongkar, mengubah kehidupan kedua-duanya.

programme.title: Kematian Yang Menyulut Pertikaian
programme.desc: Kematian Anton menjadi titik mula kekacauan dalam hidup Amalia. Misteri di sebalik kematiannya membuat Amalia dihantui persoalan dan kecurigaan, hingga dia menuduh Usman membunuh abang kandungnya sendiri. Namun tanpa disedari, Anton semasa hidup pernah curang dan mengkhianati Amalia. Apakah rahsia sebenar di sebalik kematian Anton?

programme.title: D'Academy 8
programme.desc: D'Academy 8 kembali dengan generasi baharu penyanyi dangdut berbakat yang bersaing untuk menjadi sensasi muzik seterusnya di Indonesia. Menerusi persembahan yang semakin mencabar, setiap peserta perlu menyerlahkan bukan sahaja kehebatan vokal, malah bakat seni, kebolehan serba boleh, ketahanan mental dan daya tarikan pentas. Dengan persaingan sengit serta persembahan yang memukau, hanya bintang paling menyerlah akan mara ke puncak.

programme.title: SWITCH
programme.desc: The life of a top star actor was turned upside down when he meets a taxi driver on Christmas Eve.

programme.title: 6/45: LUCKY LOTTO
programme.desc: The excitement of winning a lottery ticket doesn't last long for sergeant Chun-woo as it accidentally ends up crossing the Military Demarcation Line. He must get his act together and find it again!

programme.title: THE KING
programme.desc: Believing power is paramount, Tae-soo aspires to become a prosecutor. As he achieves his goal and rises to power, he also sees the cruelty of a life at the top hierarchy in 90's Korea.

programme.title: LOVE CLINIQUE
programme.desc: Dong-ju joins school choir for Min-soo even she is tone-deaf. They reunite 10 years later. She wants to impress him so she enrolls in a vocal training clinic where Shin-hong trains her...

programme.title: LOVE RESET
programme.desc: A couple decide to divorce after two years of marriage. They revive a 30-day divorce settlement period from the court, but then they both lost memories after a car accident...

programme.title: THE SWINDLERS
programme.desc: Though each has their own motives, unlikely individuals from different sides of the law allies together to achieve a common goal - trapping the world's most legendary con man.

programme.title: SPIRITWALKER
programme.desc: A man loses memory and wakes up in a new body every 12 hours. In search of his identity, he met a woman who claims to know him.

programme.title: THE WORLD OF LOVE
programme.desc: HIgh school student Joo-in's angry words spark rumors. She later receives anonymous notes questioning her behavior, and cracks begin to appear in her formerly peaceful world.

programme.title: THE WHISTLEBLOWER
programme.desc: A disgraced Korean researcher claims to have successfully cloned human embryo stem cells. However, the results were revealed to be fabricated along with other unethical practices later.

programme.title: GATE
programme.desc: A group of five conspired for one last heist, yet secrets inside the vault are large enough to overthrow the country.

programme.title: SUGAR: A MOTHER'S CODE
programme.desc: After her son diagnosed with diabetes, Mi-ra obtains a monitoring device that has not been released in Korea. Later, she faces claims of illegal import. Can the family spark a miracle?

programme.title: THE KILLER
programme.desc: Ui-gang, a retired hitman, reluctantly agrees to take care of a teen-aged girl Yoon-ji, but when she becomes involved with unsavory people, he shows up to rescue her and take her home.

programme.title: Global View
programme.desc: " Global View," curated by seasoned journalists, guides you to view the world with a global perspective—broadening your horizons, expanding your understanding of the news, and enriching your knowledge.

programme.title: Big Boys Club
programme.desc: " Big Boys Club" is a youth talk show hosted by a group of close friends—Bob Lam, Oscar Leung, Derek Wong, Philip Fan, and Alan Chan. In each episode, singers, entertainers, or guests from various fields are invited for relaxed interviews, presenting a wide range of topics including current social issues, pop culture, and trending interests. Matters of love, relationships, and even same-sex relationships are endlessly discussed topics for men and women alike. The show invites guests from diverse backgrounds to explore love and relationships, delving into the dynamics between the sexes. The "Other Dimension" segment features guests sharing extraordinary experiences, such as encounters with ghosts, UFOs, and bizarre happenings, bringing thrilling topics to the audience.

programme.title: Mystic Nine
programme.desc: " Mystic Nine" tells the story of Zhang Qishan (William Chan) and Wu Laogou (Joseph Zeng) joining forces with Huo Xiangu (Chen Yao) and the other members of the Nine Gates to embark on an adventure amidst renewed turmoil in Changsha. A mysterious disappearance of Unit 401 uncovers a shocking secret buried for a century. Life-or-death choices, brotherhood, sectarian duty, and national righteousness intertwine. The members of the Nine Gates use their blood and sacrifice to protect their homeland and overcome difficulties together.

programme.title: This City Never Sleeps & What's On Today
programme.desc: SLF International Group Chairman Kun Chi Sam (John Chiang) is an influential figure in Macao. This business tycoon arranges for his two sons, Kun Hao In (Julian Cheung) and Kun Hao Kuan (Ron Ng), to serve as Co-CEOs of the group, placing them on equal footing. Hao In always regards Hao Kuan as a thorn in his side. To dismantle the powerful syndicate of Hao Kuan and his wife Wong Suet Ying (Kelly Cheung), Hao In announces his marriage to Hong Kong prosecutor Hung Hoi Wan (Samantha Ko). Hoi Wan and Suet Ying both hail from R. Cino Outubro and were once buddies. However, Suet Ying became the other woman and snatched Hoi Wan's boyfriend as she wanted to marry into a wealthy family. Hao In intends to take advantage of Hoi Wan's hatred by turning it into some weapon to attack Hao Kuan and his wife. In a situation where every family member seems to be scheming, Hao Kuan adheres to righteous principles and boldly deals with Hao In's relentless maneuvers.

programme.title: Like Mother, Like Daughter
programme.desc: Public relations queen TONG MAN-LEI (Jinny Ng) raises her Gen Z daughter TONG SUM ( Desta Lee) alone and she is a control freak. MAN-LEI's mother, TONG CHO KA-BING (Stephanie Che), has spent half of her life supporting her husband and raising their children. She is suddenly "awakened" and she returns to Hong Kong from Canada. She decides to reclaim her lost time and she moves into MAN-LEI's home. Many years ago, KA-BING and her daughter completely fell out because MAN-LEI insisted to have her daughter out of wedlock. Now, KA-BING suddenly breaks in without warning and disrupts MAN-LEI's life. MAN-LEI strives to maintain order, while TONG SUM mediates between the two, creating sparks and constant conflicts in this three-generation household. In the workplace, the wealthy heir, “Marketing Guru” YEUNG FAN (Gary Chiu), is parachuted into the company to lock horns with MAN-LEI on equal footing. MAN-LEI's career and family are facing crises at the same time.

programme.title: Scoop 2026
programme.desc: "Scoop" airs from Monday to Sunday, closely following major social events and interesting stories, while also reporting the latest updates in the entertainment industry, celebrity news, as well as drama promotions and behind-the-scenes features. The "Today's Breaking News" segment keeps viewers up to date with the day's hottest stories. The in-depth feature section explores current affairs, social, and livelihood issues that the public cares about, interviewing relevant experts for their insights.

programme.title: Who Heals the Healers?
programme.desc: Doctors have said "You're sick" countless times, but rarely have they heard it said to themselves. The news department's Fang Dongsheng team is out in force again, still searching for the "patient" who least resembles a patient—the doctor. They are usually quick, decisive, and accurate in their actions, accustomed to life and death, but when the roles are reversed, becoming patients or caregivers on the sickbed, they too experience avoidance and anxiety. The gods in the public eye are ultimately just ordinary people. How do doctors who save others save themselves? The new program, "Doctor, Are You Sick?", delves into the difficult reality of doctors' lives, examining their vulnerability and struggles, and revealing the most authentic, flesh-and-blood human stories behind the white coats.

programme.title: Demi-Gods and Semi-Devils (2021)
programme.desc: Mr. Jin Yong created a magnificent martial arts world for readers, and *Demi-Gods and Semi-Devils* is one of the most beloved and sought-after masterpieces in his novel series. Its classic status is self-evident, and it remains a popular subject for adaptation. Set in the Northern Song Dynasty during the reign of Emperor Zhezong, the story follows the adventures, love, and hatred of three characters: Qiao Feng (played by Yang Youning), the leader of the Beggars' Sect; Duan Yu (played by Bai Shu), the prince of Dali; and Xu Zhu (played by Zhang Tianyang), a young monk from Shaolin Temple. It also explores the complex web of martial arts grudges and the inescapable cycle of greed, anger, and delusion, painting a vivid picture of human relationships and symbolizing that all beings in the world are ultimately bound by the painful entanglements brought about by "love."

programme.title: Big City Shop 2026
programme.desc: “Big City Shop” introduces viewers to a wide range of timely topics, including seasonal products, health and wellness, fitness activities, skincare and makeup, fashion apparel, infant care, parenting knowledge, local delicacies, and pet care trends. The content is all-encompassing! In addition to hands-on demonstrations, experiences, or tests by the hosts, experts are invited to share their professional insights. In the cooking segment, several skilled culinary experts take turns showcasing simple and delicious healthy dishes and home-style recipes, helping everyone solve their cooking challenges.

programme.title: Happy Old Buddies
programme.desc: Many people may think that older adults do not have sexual needs, but surveys have shown that this is not the case—older adults often experience less sexual activity due to various reasons. Clinical psychologist Lin Haoming from the Social Welfare Department explains the World Health Organization's definition of sexuality and offers advice for those hoping to rekindle their sex life with their partner. However, if one partner does not wish to resume sexual activity, how should both sides communicate?

programme.title: Cantoxicating! (Sr.4)
programme.desc: The Cantonese word "gaigui" (??) is vivid and profound, with many Hong Kong slang terms originating from various parts of Guangdong Province. Gaigui Ambassador Mayanne Mak has expanded her exploration to China, inviting Tang Chi-kin, Thye Cho-yee, and Hui Man-hin to join the "Gaigui Guided Tour" to delve into inland cities like Guangzhou, uncovering interesting anecdotes and origins. Professional Cantonese and historical experts will also appear, tracing origins and citing classical texts to reveal the charm of local Cantonese. Furthermore, Tang Chi-kin, who enjoys playing pranks, will transform into a single, nerdy man on the show, showcasing his pursuit of various "goddesses" and helping viewers understand the meanings of many slang terms and idioms.

programme.title: Just Love
programme.desc: Judge KO HEI MAN (HSUAN JESSICA HESTER) and KOT KWOK KWONG (CHAN KAM HUNG, SUNNY) have agreed that MAN will concentrate on her career while KWONG will be taking care of the housework after they get married. Everything is in harmony until KWONG's father discovers MAN and KWONG's pre-marriage written agreement. Their relationship complicates ever since. To make things worse, KWONG breaks the agreement and demands to have his own career. MAN does not pay much attention at first until she finds out that KWONG, who is free from family burden, is having an affair. MAN learns to become more affectionate in the hope of saving the marriage. Unfortunately, the whole situation deteriorates when KWONG decides that MAN is too close to her ex-boyfriend, TAI CHI HUNG (WANG CHIEH, DAVE), who is now MAN's colleague. Who has the right to decide who should be in charge of earning money instead of running the family?

Even takeout-only eateries with no dine-in option are in high demand—what are the must-try picks? Running a food business inevitably comes with its own mix of sweet, sour, bitter, and spicy experiences. The production team follows the proprietors through their busy day, from sourcing ingredients and preparing materials to opening for business, uncovering the "stories behind the flavors."

programme.title: Chill. Hike. Camping
programme.desc: With travel restricted due to the pandemic, many people have opted to connect with nature and discover the joys of local outings and camping. Four former Miss Hong Kong contestants—Ho Wing-sau, Liu Wai-yee, Wu Mei-yee, and Chan Yeuk-sze—set aside their formalities and escaped the hustle and bustle of city life, joining various "outdoor experts" on adventures. They explored mountains and seas, experiencing outdoor activities like picnics, mountain art photography, car parking, diving, kitesurfing, and even taking on challenges like mountain art tests, boating to collect trash on deserted beaches, and rappelling on a deserted island. These diverse outdoor activities included experiencing a flash flood and witnessing the power of nature! Will they ultimately become Hong Kong "wild women" with exceptional physical strength, willpower, and environmental awareness?

The new program, "Doctor, Are You Sick?", delves into the difficult reality of doctors' lives, examining their vulnerability and struggles, and revealing the most authentic, flesh-and-blood human stories behind the white coats.

programme.desc: Private detective Ouyang uncovers his wife's betrayal during an investigation. Reeling from the shock, he abandons a missing person case. Soon after, the missing person turns up dead. Inspector Chen suspects a serial killer may be at large. Now drawn back into the case, Ouyang must use his skills to stop the killer before another life is taken.

programme.title: Measure in Love
programme.desc: A massive earthquake splits the world into two regions where time flows at different speeds. During a medical relief mission, student An Qing meets Shu Zai, and an extraordinary bond begins. Yet with every reunion, he ages rapidly while she remains unchanged, forcing them to confront a love challenged by time, distance, and fate.

programme.title: Bodyguards And Assassins
programme.desc: On 15 October 1906, Chinese revolutionary leader Sun Yat Sen returned to Hong Kong to stage another overthrow of the Qing dynasty. Businessman Lee and Chinese Daily's Chief Chan arrange for five bodyguards to protect Mr Sun - these are all extraordinary fighters who are ready and up for fierce battles against the Qing assassination army.

programme.title: Cape No. 7
programme.desc: A Taiwanese singer tries to deliver seven old love letters attentioned to a Tomoko. As he falls in love with a young Japanese model also named Tomoko, he unravels their serendipitous connection.

programme.title: The Sorcerer & The White Snake
programme.desc: In this action fantasy movie based on the Chinese legend of the White Snake, a young herbalist falls in love with a thousand-year-old white snake disguised as a woman. When the white snake's true identity is revealed, a sorcerer goes to battle believing that in doing so, he is restoring balance and order between man and the supernatural.

programme.title: Death Stranding
programme.desc: To overhaul the underground gambling industry, the police join hands with the gambling association to crack down on illegal casinos. They auction off new casino licenses to regulate the industry, but this results in an upheaval in the gambling world, unveiling the hidden interests and secrets while sparking conflicts between gangs...

programme.title: Table for Six
programme.desc: In this comedy, three brothers reside in a home inherited from their late parents. The eldest brother insists they have dinner at home every night as a family, but tensions begin to rise when their girlfriends join in as well. Love, friendship, jealousy and complicated relationships are all on the menu for this table for six!

programme.title: Cold War
programme.desc: A hijacking of a police van occurs when the Police Commissioner is away from Hong Kong. Deputy Commissioner Lee leads a rescue operation code-named Cold War. Fellow Deputy Commissioner Sean moves to take control from Lee as he thinks Lee is emotionally affected by his son being held hostage, but the efforts end up threatening both their reputation.

programme.title: Call Me Agent
programme.desc: Miu Ling dreams of becoming a secret agent. Even though it seems impossible, she still harbours such a dream and hopes that it will soon come true. One day, Miu Ling rescues an injured secret agent who promises to make her his apprentice. From then on, her life is turned upside down and she goes onto a roller-coaster of madcap adventures.

programme.title: Bursting Point
programme.desc: Senior Inspector Bang sends Officer Ming undercover to a drug cartel to displace drug lord Yang. A failed raid triggers Yang's rage for revenge. Meanwhile, drug maker Ying Xiu is forced to cooperate with the police and sets a trap for Yang. The battle between the police and the drug cartel has just begun!

programme.title: Always Have Always Will
programme.desc: A struggling young man unexpectedly meets an optimistic, spirited young girl, and together they set off on an uncertain, soul-healing journey. Through life's highs and lows, they stand by each other in hardship, their companionship mending the wounds they carry and reigniting hope in life's darkest moments.

programme.title: Shinjuku Incident
programme.desc: Chinese immigrant Steelhead struggles to survive in Tokyo alongside fellow migrants before rising to establish a new triad. Just as he secures legal residency and decides to leave the underworld behind, a police crackdown and betrayal by his own brothers force him back into a ruthless battle for survival.

programme.title: Dead To Rights
programme.desc: During the 1937 Nanjing Massacre, civilians hiding in Ji Xiang Studio are forced to develop film for the Japanese army, only to uncover photographic evidence of its atrocities. Risking execution if discovered, they decide to preserve the negatives and expose the truth, determined to reveal the horrors of the massacre to the world.

programme.title: The Pure and the Evil
programme.desc: Two teen girls, Rose and May, become close friends despite their different social backgrounds. The rich girl May moves to America but returns years later to see Rose, now a beauty queen and bar girl. Rose is immediately attracted to Fang's fiancé and their relationship quickly deteriorates when Rose sets out to pursue him…

programme.title: Forever Diamonds
programme.desc: Hua, a clever beauty, teams up with her brother to stage a jewel heist and plans to sell the loot in Singapore. To evade customs, she slips a diamond ring into the pocket of a fellow passenger, Zhang Zhi Xian, only to lose him after landing. Forced to track him down, Hua resorts to a series of clumsy schemes to get close and retrieve the ring.

programme.title: Till the End of Time
programme.desc: Ming marries singer Ling, defying his wealthy father and severing family ties. When Ling becomes pregnant, Ming's overwork causes him to lose his sight. To support their home, Ling returns to the stage but Ming leaves to avoid becoming a burden. Encouraged by a friend, Ling performs again, and her song moves Ming to reunite with his wife and child.

programme.title: Fangs of the Cobra
programme.desc: Incredibly, the title serpent is not a harbinger of horror, but actually the film's hero. This virtuous viper sniffs out bombs, fights gangs, battles a baby-killing rodent and even takes on a duplicitous woman. This one-of-a-kind thriller will be applauded by reptile fans everywhere.

programme.title: The Delinquent
programme.desc: This is a coming-of-age tale depicting the lower class Hong Kong troubled youths in the 1960s and the societal issues that they face. Wang Chung is a hotheaded and rebellious teen who is tempted by the dark side, and have to unfortunately pay a huge price for it.

programme.title: Apartment For Ladies
programme.desc: A Taiwanese singer comes to Hong Kong in search for her missing younger sister, who had arrived in Hong Kong to be discovered as a nightclub singer. She finds lodging at an apartment for women run by a man-hating landlady, Mrs Chan. However, Mrs Chan cannot confine the young ladies' youthful vitality within the apartment.

programme.title: Rendezvous With Death
programme.desc: Sun Chung had been recognized as an expert comedy and crime thriller director, but he was to gain even greater acclaim for his soulful, powerful, intelligent, and beautifully-made martial arts epics. This stands alongside The Deadly Breaking Sword and The Kung-fu Instructor as one of his very best. It's not so much the plot - a master swordsman protects a treasure chest on a dangerous journey - that makes this great, but what Sun does with it, inspiring the cast and crew to some of their finest work.

programme.title: Emperor Chien Lung
programme.desc: Emperor Chien Lung goes incognito to mix with his people and understand their needs. He encounters many strange things along the way, including being arrested and nearly beheaded. Who will save him?

programme.title: Pursuit of a Killer
programme.desc: The charm of Pursuit Of A Killer lies in the long awaited reunion of Five Venoms duo, Lo Meng and Sun Chien; Lo Meng, who plays a Mainland Chinese criminal escapee to Hong Kong in search of a better life, and a cop (Sun Chien) who helps him adjust to Hong Kong life while tracking down his mysterious killer at the same time.

programme.title: The Bride Napping
programme.desc: A rich girl Yue Ying, together with her maid Chun Lan, encounter a poor scholar Bian Ji at a fête. Chun Lan realizes Yue Ying is in love with him, but mixes his identity with a bandit due to an old servant's confusion, threatening the couple's union. After a series of complications, misunderstandings and mismatches, Chun Lan finally saves the day.

programme.title: The Killer Has No Return
programme.desc: Professional killer Lui goes to Malaysia after completing his mission of killing the big boss of a Hong Kong gang. His next target is a groom who is throwing his wedding banquet at a hotel in Chinatown. Just when Lui takes aim at his target, another victim instead of the groom is shot, and he becomes a scapegoat in this mystery assassination.

programme.title: Kopi Pahit
programme.desc: Pasangan pengantin baru, Gendis dan Joel, yang terpaksa dikuarantin di hotel selama tujuh hari selepas pulang berbulan madu. Hubungan mereka diuji apabila gangguan daripada bekas kekasih Joel mencetuskan rasa cemburu dan pertengkaran hebat akibat emosi Gendis yang sensitif.

programme.title: Isteri Dalam Sangkar
programme.desc: Majlis persandingan berlangsung, Aisyah meniti rasa bahagianya meskipun dia tidak tahu apakah alasan dia harus sebahagia ini. Aisyah melihat kehadiran Ros , keluarga Rokiah dan Keluarga Anim di majlis itu. Kehadiran keluarga Mak Su Ainin membuatkan hati Aisyah semakin bahagia. Namun tidak pada Ros, dia merasakan ada sesuatu yang tidak kena akan berlaku kepada Aisyah. Ros sentiasa memerhatikan kelakuan Mak Su Ainin, Fasha dan Farid di majlis itu. Jelas, mereka masih cuba untuk menyakiti Aisyah dengan meletakkan ubat julap ke dalam air minuman Aisyah. Ros tidak berseorangan, dia dan Haziq bekerjasama untuk mengelak hal itu dari berlaku. Ros dan Haziq telah menukar air yang telah diletakkan julap itu. Sebaliknya bukan Aisyah yang terkena tetapi mereka sekeluarga. Rey yang menyimpan dendam terhadap Iskandar turut hadir ke majlis persandingan itu tanpa di undang. Rey membuat percubaan untuk membunuh Aisyah dan Iskandar ketika mereka sedang bersanding. Mujur Waiduri ternampak kelibat lelaki yang kelihatan pelik itu di majlsi persandingan. Mereka sempat menghalang tindakan Rey yang menutup mukanya dengan kain dan malangnya Rey sempat melarikan diri. Iskandar cuba menenangkan Aisyah. Sementara Tengku Maria berasa amat marah dan mahu setiap orang yang cuba mengganggu majlis persandingan itu di tangkap. Iskandar dan Aisyah berazam mahu memulakan kembali hubungan suami isterin mereka dengan perasaan yang baru. Iskandar tidak lagi mahu memaksa Aisyah untuk menerima dirinya. Masa yang menentukan menjadi jalan terbaik buat Iskandar untuk terus bahagia bersama Aisyah.

programme.title: Kopi Pahit
programme.desc: Pasangan pengantin baru, Gendis dan Joel, yang terpaksa dikuarantin di hotel selama tujuh hari selepas pulang berbulan madu. Hubungan mereka diuji apabila gangguan daripada bekas kekasih Joel mencetuskan rasa cemburu dan pertengkaran hebat akibat emosi Gendis yang sensitif.

programme.title: Isteri Dalam Sangkar
programme.desc: Majlis persandingan berlangsung, Aisyah meniti rasa bahagianya meskipun dia tidak tahu apakah alasan dia harus sebahagia ini. Aisyah melihat kehadiran Ros , keluarga Rokiah dan Keluarga Anim di majlis itu. Kehadiran keluarga Mak Su Ainin membuatkan hati Aisyah semakin bahagia. Namun tidak pada Ros, dia merasakan ada sesuatu yang tidak kena akan berlaku kepada Aisyah. Ros sentiasa memerhatikan kelakuan Mak Su Ainin, Fasha dan Farid di majlis itu. Jelas, mereka masih cuba untuk menyakiti Aisyah dengan meletakkan ubat julap ke dalam air minuman Aisyah. Ros tidak berseorangan, dia dan Haziq bekerjasama untuk mengelak hal itu dari berlaku. Ros dan Haziq telah menukar air yang telah diletakkan julap itu. Sebaliknya bukan Aisyah yang terkena tetapi mereka sekeluarga. Rey yang menyimpan dendam terhadap Iskandar turut hadir ke majlis persandingan itu tanpa di undang. Rey membuat percubaan untuk membunuh Aisyah dan Iskandar ketika mereka sedang bersanding. Mujur Waiduri ternampak kelibat lelaki yang kelihatan pelik itu di majlsi persandingan. Mereka sempat menghalang tindakan Rey yang menutup mukanya dengan kain dan malangnya Rey sempat melarikan diri. Iskandar cuba menenangkan Aisyah. Sementara Tengku Maria berasa amat marah dan mahu setiap orang yang cuba mengganggu majlis persandingan itu di tangkap. Iskandar dan Aisyah berazam mahu memulakan kembali hubungan suami isterin mereka dengan perasaan yang baru. Iskandar tidak lagi mahu memaksa Aisyah untuk menerima dirinya. Masa yang menentukan menjadi jalan terbaik buat Iskandar untuk terus bahagia bersama Aisyah.

programme.title: Sedingin Cinta Antasya
programme.desc: Datin Jasmin menculik Razali dan memerangkap Hana datang ke gudang. Datin Jasmin mengeluarkan pistol dan cuba menembak mereka di situ. Datin Jamsin rebah ditembak Hana apabila Hana berjaya mendapatkan pistol. Antasya menyangka Syarfan telah menembak ayahnya. Hana memukul kepala Antasya. Antasya rebah.

Namun, perkahwinan tanpa cinta mengundang kesedihan buat Damia apabila Airel lebih mengutamakan tugasnya. Sementara itu, Irfan dan Maisarah bahagia meneruskan pertunangan mereka.

Damia pula mengejar cita-cita sebagai model, manakala Airel semakin tertekan apabila mengetahui Sara sudah bertunang dengan Irfan.

programme.title: Sedingin Cinta Antasya
programme.desc: Antasya koma. Syarfan membesarkan Isabella sendirian. Hana telah ditangkap polis. Antasya mengalami amnesia dan Syarfan berjaya menyakinkan bahwa dia adalah suaminya. Hidup mereka damai dan gembira. Najwan meluahkan isi hatinya kepada Syafinaz dan diterima seikhlas hati. Alia turut menerima Nazrin yang bersungguh mengambil hatinya.

programme.title: Once Upon A Time In China II
programme.desc: Tiba dengan kereta api di Guangzhou pada tahun 1895, ketiga-tiga mereka melawan pengikut White Lotus, yang ingin membunuh semua orang asing dan Mak Cik ke-13 yang comel dan berpakaian Eropah. Ia bukanlah pertarungan terakhir pakar kung fu Dr. Wong (Jet Li).

programme.title: The Equalizer S2 EP17
programme.desc: Seorang psikik yang mengaku dirinya sendiri mendakwa adik perempuannya yang hilang berada dalam bahaya yang akan berlaku, menurut penglihatannya; Delilah bergelut di bawah beban menyimpan rahsia McCall.

programme.title: Paku
programme.desc: Filem ini mengisahkan tentang Fahmi (Johan As'ari) yang amat mencintai isterinya Riana (Aishah Ilias) dan dia tidak dapat menerima kenyataan bahawa isterinya sudah meninggal dunia. Oleh kerna disebabkan ketaksuban cintanya itu membuatkan Fahmi sanggup mencari seorang bomoh untuk menghidupkan semula Riana. Riana telah berjaya dihidupkan semula dan mereka bersatu sehinggalah Riana melahirkan seorang anak. Namun benarkah itu adalah Riana? Apakah yang akan terjadi kepada kehidupan Fahmi selepas itu?

programme.title: Brick Mansion
programme.desc: Di Detroit dystopian, rumah besar yang pernah menempatkan orang kaya kini menjadi rumah penjenayah paling berbahaya di bandar itu. Di sekeliling kawasan itu terdapat tembok gergasi untuk memastikan seluruh Detroit selamat. Bagi polis yang menyamar Damien Collier, setiap hari adalah perjuangan menentang rasuah ketika dia berjuang untuk membawa pembunuh bapanya, Tremaine, ke muka pengadilan. Sementara itu, Damien dan bekas penipu bernama Lino bekerjasama untuk menyelamatkan bandar itu daripada komplot untuk memusnahkannya.

programme.title: Golden Job
programme.desc: Sekumpulan bekas tentera upahan bersatu semula untuk merancang rompakan epik: meningkatkan trak penuh ubat yang dipegang oleh agensi perisikan asing untuk membekalkan kem pelarian yang memerlukan. Tetapi apabila mereka mendapati trak itu benar-benar dipenuhi dengan emas yang dicuri, kumpulan saudara-saudara itu menyedari bahawa mereka telah diserang dua kali oleh salah seorang daripada mereka sendiri - dan meletakkan keadaan yang betul akan menjadi perang habis-habisan.

programme.title: Congkak
programme.desc: Kisahnya bermula apabila Kazman serta isterinya Sufiah mengambil keputusan bercuti bersama dua anaknya, Lisa dan Ely di sebuah banglo di tepi tasik. Kazman sudah berjanji dengan seorang kawannya untuk membeli banglo tersebut sebagai persinggahan semasa bercuti. Pelbagai peristiwa pelik berlaku sepanjang perjalan mereka termasuk kehilangan telefon bimbitnya. Setibanya mereka di banglo tersebut, peristiwa yang semakin pelik turut terjadi. Sufiah cuba meyakinkan Kazman untuk keluar dari rumah tersebut tetapi tidak diendahkan. Kazman tetap berkeras untuk membeli rumah tersebut kerana sudah berjanji dengan kawannya. Sufiah sentiasa merasakan ada makhluk sedang memerhatikannya. Salah seorang anak mereka, Lisa setiap malam akan turun ke sebuah bilik gelap untuk bermain congkak dengan seseorang yang hanya boleh dilihat olehnya seorang. Sufiah yang tidak boleh bersabar dengan perkara itu telah membuang congkak tersebut ke dalam tasik. Lisa juga sentiasa bermain di tepi belukar di belakang rumah kerana kawannya tinggal di situ sehingga Kazman perasan Lisa bermain menghadap kubur lama. Pada malam keesokannya, Sufiah dikejutkan lagi dengan bunyi congkak tersebut dari bilik yang sama. Apabila Sufiah pergi melihat, dilihatnya seorang tua sedang bemain congkak tersebut. Semakin lama peristiwa yang berlaku semakin pelik dan menyeramkan sehingga pada malam ketiga kedua-dua anaknya telah hilang dan Sufiah didapati tidur di siling bilik. Pak Tua, penduduk paling lama di kampung itu telah pergi ke rumah tersebut untuk menyelamatkan keluarga Kazman dan mencari Ely dan Lisa. Apakah sejarah sebenar banglo tersebut dan dapatkan Sufiah diselamatkan serta berjayakah Ely dan Lisa ditemui semula.

Nita menagih kasih sayang kedua ibu bapanya. Ingin bertunang dengan Idris namun ibunya ingin menjodohkan Nita bersama anak Datuk Hamzah.

programme.title: Perjanjian Syaitan
programme.desc: Tambun membunuh Tok Kadim, penghulu di sebuah kampung dan kemudiannya mengatakan bahawa Tok Kadim mati satu kemalangan. Selepas kejadian itu, Tambun dilantik menjadi ketua kampung yang baharu. Pada masa yang sama, Ribut, adik kepada Tambun yang berwajah hodoh ingin membalas dendam kepada Ujang kerana menolak cintanya dan memilih Seri sebagai teman. Ribut bersahabat dengan syaitan yang berjanji untuk menjadikannya seorang perempuan cantik. Sejak itulah Ribut berusaha untuk membalas dendam sehingga berlaku beberapa siri kematian yang penuh misteri.

programme.title: Putera
programme.desc: Putera Hussein, pewaris takhta kerajaan Nusantara yang tidak mahu dijodohkan dengan sepupunya, Puteri Balkis. Ayahanda Putera Hussein memberi tempoh selama 30 hari kepadanya untuk mencari bakal isteri. Putera Hussein menyamar sebagai rakyat biasa dan bertemu dengan seorang gadis bernama Noraini. Mereka berdua jatuh cinta namun percintaan itu mendapat halangan keluarga Noraini.

programme.title: Duhai Si Pari-Pari
programme.desc: Mengisahkan Syadon, seorang pemuda yang mencintai Mala. Pada suatu hari, Syadon bertemu seorang gadis bernama Pari yang sedang mencari kekasihnya. Semakin hari, Pari semakin suntuk waktu yang Pari ada untuk mengahwini jejaka idamannya dan pulang ke dunia kayangan. Syadon bertanya siapakah Pari yang sebenarnya dan setelah diterangkan, dia sukar mempercayainya. Pari terpaksa membuktikan kata-katanya dengan menunaikan permintaan Syadon.

programme.title: Soal Hati
programme.desc: Daniel ialah seorang lelaki playboy kaya yang mempunyai perniagaan yang berjaya. Dia mula berubah setelah jatuh cinta pandang pertama dengan Nurul Ain, seorang gadis kampung yang bekerja sebagai jurujual. Daniel berusaha untuk memikat Nurul Ain dengan berpura-pura menjadi seorang lelaki biasa bernama Ahmad namun akhirnya diketahui oleh Nurul Ain. Dapatkan Daniel memikat hati Nurul Ain kembali?

programme.title: Dendam Dari Pusara
programme.desc: Dolah, seorang buruh kasar yang cacat kaki sejak kecil mempunyai ilmu luar biasa yang diperolehinya dengan memotong dagu si mati dijadikan minyak tetapi perlu mematuhi syarat ketat dengan memulangkan barang-barang yang diperolehi dalam tempoh seribu hari. . Dolah melakukan kerja ngeri ini dengan bantuan dua orang kawannya, tetapi pada suatu masa dia telah gagal memenuhi syarat tersebut dan bermacam kejadian telah berlaku selepas itu.

programme.title: Lurah Dendam
programme.desc: Sekumpulan ahli payung terjun yang diketuai Kapten Hanafi dalam penerbangan untuk membuat penerjunan di Kuantan. Kapal terbang yang mereka naiki terlanggar seekor burung helang dan mengakibatkan pesawat itu bergegar. Dalam keadaan kelam kabut itu, seorang demi seorang penerjun melompat keluar dan mendarat di sebuah kawasan hutan. Di sana, mereka diganggu pelbagai peristiwa dan menganggap tempat itu berpuaka. Namun, Kapten Hanafi mengesyaki semua peristiwa itu adalah berpunca daripada perbuatan manusia.

programme.title: Karipap-Karipap Cinta
programme.desc: Ali bekerja sebagai jurufoto di syarikat penerbitan majalah jatuh hati kepada Sarah, seorang lulusan Universiti Al-Azhar. Ali panik apabila rakan serumahnya memberitahu keluarga Sarah ingin menjodohkannya dengan seorang ustaz. Untuk memenangi hati Sarah dan keluarganya, Ali terpaksa berbohong dengan mengatakan dia juga merupakan seorang graduan Universiti Al-Azhar. Dalam masa yang sama bos Ali, Dato' Razali Bunari cuba mendedahkan satu skandal yang turut melibatkan bapa Sarah.

programme.title: Seri Dewi Malam
programme.desc: Cinta seorang isteri kepada suami yang sangat kuat membuatkannya ingin terus berjuang untuk hidup. Azri menemui jalan untuk berkomunikasi bersama isterinya, Seri yang jatuh koma. Dewi, seorang gadis buta yang memboleh membaca minda memutuskan untuk membantu Azri berhubung dengan Seri. Lama kelamaan, perasaan cinta mula muncul dan Azri harus membuat pilihan yang sukar.

programme.title: Sate
programme.desc: Milah ialah seorang peniaga sate dan kedai satenya terletak di hadapan bengkel kepunyaan Kadir yang suka melakukan eksperimen aneh. Kadir ingin menyertai Anugerah Saintis untuk memenangi hadiah utama dan sekaligus menyenangkan hidup Milah. Pelbagai rintangan terpaksa dia lalui untuk mencipta mesin miliknya dan akhirnya Kadir berjaya menyiapkan mesin tersebut dan menyertai pertandingan itu.

programme.title: Perjanjian Syaitan
programme.desc: Tambun membunuh Tok Kadim, penghulu di sebuah kampung dan kemudiannya mengatakan bahawa Tok Kadim mati satu kemalangan. Selepas kejadian itu, Tambun dilantik menjadi ketua kampung yang baharu. Pada masa yang sama, Ribut, adik kepada Tambun yang berwajah hodoh ingin membalas dendam kepada Ujang kerana menolak cintanya dan memilih Seri sebagai teman. Ribut bersahabat dengan syaitan yang berjanji untuk menjadikannya seorang perempuan cantik. Sejak itulah Ribut berusaha untuk membalas dendam sehingga berlaku beberapa siri kematian yang penuh misteri.

programme.title: Duhai Si Pari-Pari
programme.desc: Mengisahkan Syadon, seorang pemuda yang mencintai Mala. Pada suatu hari, Syadon bertemu seorang gadis bernama Pari yang sedang mencari kekasihnya. Semakin hari, Pari semakin suntuk waktu yang Pari ada untuk mengahwini jejaka idamannya dan pulang ke dunia kayangan. Syadon bertanya siapakah Pari yang sebenarnya dan setelah diterangkan, dia sukar mempercayainya. Pari terpaksa membuktikan kata-katanya dengan menunaikan permintaan Syadon.

programme.title: Enam Batang
programme.desc: Mengisahkan pasangan suami isteri Arya dan Niken yang pada awalnya hidup bahagia, namun hubungan mereka mula goyah selepas Arya bertemu semula dengan bekas kekasihnya, Maia, ketika menghadiri reunion kampus. Kehadiran Maia menguji kepercayaan dan kesetiaan dalam rumah tangga mereka

programme.title: Kapan Pindah Rumah
programme.desc: Mengisahkan Ariel dan Lydia yang memutuskan untuk berpindah rumah selepas berkahwin, namun proses mencari dan menyesuaikan diri dengan rumah baharu membawa pelbagai cabaran, konflik keluarga serta kisah lucu dalam kehidupan rumah tangga merek

programme.title: Pontianak 100kg
programme.desc: Mengisahkan Melati, seorang gadis yang suka makan dan meninggal dunia dalam keadaan lapar. Selepas berubah menjadi pontianak, dia menghantui penduduk kampung bukan untuk menghisap darah, tetapi mencari makanan sehingga berat badannya menjadi 100kg. Penduduk kampung cuba mencari cara untuk menghentikan gangguan tersebu

programme.title: #BerhentiDiKamu
programme.desc: Dr. Gia percaya Elsa ialah jodohnya selepas berdoa di Kaabah, namun selepas cintanya ditolak, dia bertemu Syafira yang juga sedang kecewa, lalu kedua-duanya menemui semula makna cinta, takdir dan kehidupan.

programme.title: Dunia Baru The Movie
programme.desc: Filem ini bermula apabila Opie menemui sepucuk surat daripada Anizah yang menyatakan bahawa dia ingin berkahwin dengan teman lelakinya, Fazley, dan telah menguburkan impiannya untuk menyambung pelajaran ke UK.

programme.title: Gol & Gincu
programme.desc: Kisah Putri yang cuba memenangi semula hati teman lelakinya dengan menyertai pertandingan futsal wanita bersama rakan-rakannya. Sepanjang perjalanan itu, mereka belajar tentang persahabatan, keyakinan diri dan makna sebenar cinta.

programme.title: Gol & Gincu 2
programme.desc: Sekuel kepada Gol & Gincu yang mengikuti kehidupan Putri dan rakan-rakannya selepas beberapa tahun. Mereka menghadapi cabaran baharu dalam kerjaya, cinta dan persahabatan, sambil cuba mengekalkan hubungan rapat yang telah lama terjalin.

programme.title: One, Two, Trivia
programme.desc: Sebuah program yang merungkai fakta-fakta menarik yang tersimpan dalam filem-filem klasik tempatan

programme.title: Sejoli
programme.desc: Jo (Bront Palarae) dan Gina (Maya Karin) sedang menyembuhkan hati yang terluka di Phuket apabila takdir mempertemukan mereka. Pada mulanya mereka saling membenci, tetapi apabila mereka mendapat tahu bahawa bekas kekasih masing-masing, Hardy (Remy Ishak) dan Nita (Izara Aishah), akan berkahwin, mereka merancang untuk menggagalkan majlis perkahwinan tersebut.

programme.title: Lebuhraya Ke Neraka
programme.desc: Lebuhraya Ke Neraka mengisahkan sekumpulan penunggang motosikal yang kasar berhenti di tepi jalan, dan tidak lama kemudian, kesemua mereka—kecuali Bob—jatuh sakit secara misteri.

programme.title: Gerabak Cinta
programme.desc: Mengisahkan Luna, usahawan berjaya yang ditipu tunangnya, Razi. Dia kecewa apabila perniagaan yang mereka usahakan rugi kerana Razi terbabit dengan skandal wang serta mempunyai perempuan simpanan. Sementara itu, Gie pula baru saja dibuang kerja. Walaupun masih mencari kerja, dia sangat tenang dan tetap ceria. Gie reda dengan situasi menimpanya.

programme.title: Reaksiar
programme.desc: Program yang memaparkan perkongsian pengalaman dan reaksi artis-artis jemputan setelah melihat kembali klip-klip lakonan mereka.

programme.title: Gila Gila Remaja 2
programme.desc: Filem ni adalah sekuel kepada Gila-Gila Remaja (1985). Ia bawa vibe remaja moden dengan konflik cinta, persahabatan, dan cabaran zaman baru. Kisahnya lebih fokus pada hidup remaja kolej & sekolah memandu, dengan isu sosial yang dekat dengan golongan muda — persaingan, cinta segitiga, serta impian masing-masing.

programme.desc: Ui-gang, a retired hitman, reluctantly agrees to take care of a teen-aged girl Yoon-ji, but when she becomes involved with unsavory people, he shows up to rescue her and take her home.

programme.desc: 10 years ago, the mafia family welcomed the entrepreneur Dae-suh as the son-in-law. They set up a company and Dae-Suh becomes the president. The family plot a conspiracy against him...

programme.desc: After being released from prison, a man learns that he has a daughter, thus wishes to leave the gangs and live an ordinary life. Yet the new leader of the gangs feels being betrayed...

programme.desc: An undercover cop spends eight years to infiltrate South Korea's largest crime organization. When the head of the organization is killed, he becomes torn between his loyalties.

programme.title: I (2021)
programme.desc: Ah-Young who grew up in an orphanage becomes the babysitter of Young-Chae, who is raising a 6-month-old child on her own. One day, her child has an accident and she places all the blame on Ah-Young...

programme.desc: Um Bok-dong, a cyclist who won a match during the Japanese colonial era, alerts the colonial authorities and galvanizes the locals, especially freedom fighters who have invested in the races.

programme.title: STEEL RAIN: SUMMIT
programme.desc: A peace summit for Korea is derailed when the leaders of South Korea, North Korea and the U.S. are abducted by North Korean hardliners and held hostage in a submarine.

programme.title: SAMJIN COMPANY ENGLISH CLASS
programme.desc: In the mid-1990s in South Korea, three female office co-workers who enroll in English classes in hopes to advance their careers, struggle to expose the corruption inside their company.

programme.title: TAZZA: THE HIDDEN CARD
programme.desc: Go-ni's nephew, Ham Dae-gil, enters the gambling underworld only to be used as a scapegoat in a deal gone wrong. Now he's planning his revenge by entering one big fatal game.

programme.title: THE EXCLUSIVE: BEAT THE DEVIL'S TATTOO
programme.desc: When a journalist discovers that his exclusive story on a serial killer was based on false information, he fabricates more lies to cover his mistake.

programme.title: RETURN OF THE MAFIA
programme.desc: 10 years ago, the mafia family welcomed the entrepreneur Dae-suh as the son-in-law. They set up a company and Dae-Suh becomes the president. The family plot a conspiracy against him...

programme.title: MEN OF PLASTIC
programme.desc: A natural-born networker spot potential for business when he met a top plastic surgeon by chance. Together, they decided to open a whole new era of Apgujeong.

programme.title: Global View
programme.desc: " Global View," curated by seasoned journalists, guides you to view the world with a global perspective—broadening your horizons, expanding your understanding of the news, and enriching your knowledge.

programme.title: Big Boys Club
programme.desc: " Big Boys Club" is a youth talk show hosted by a group of close friends—Bob Lam, Oscar Leung, Derek Wong, Philip Fan, and Alan Chan. In each episode, singers, entertainers, or guests from various fields are invited for relaxed interviews, presenting a wide range of topics including current social issues, pop culture, and trending interests. Matters of love, relationships, and even same-sex relationships are endlessly discussed topics for men and women alike. The show invites guests from diverse backgrounds to explore love and relationships, delving into the dynamics between the sexes. The "Other Dimension" segment features guests sharing extraordinary experiences, such as encounters with ghosts, UFOs, and bizarre happenings, bringing thrilling topics to the audience.

programme.title: Mystic Nine
programme.desc: " Mystic Nine" tells the story of Zhang Qishan (William Chan) and Wu Laogou (Joseph Zeng) joining forces with Huo Xiangu (Chen Yao) and the other members of the Nine Gates to embark on an adventure amidst renewed turmoil in Changsha. A mysterious disappearance of Unit 401 uncovers a shocking secret buried for a century. Life-or-death choices, brotherhood, sectarian duty, and national righteousness intertwine. The members of the Nine Gates use their blood and sacrifice to protect their homeland and overcome difficulties together.

programme.title: This City Never Sleeps & What's On Today
programme.desc: SLF International Group Chairman Kun Chi Sam (John Chiang) is an influential figure in Macao. This business tycoon arranges for his two sons, Kun Hao In (Julian Cheung) and Kun Hao Kuan (Ron Ng), to serve as Co-CEOs of the group, placing them on equal footing. Hao In always regards Hao Kuan as a thorn in his side. To dismantle the powerful syndicate of Hao Kuan and his wife Wong Suet Ying (Kelly Cheung), Hao In announces his marriage to Hong Kong prosecutor Hung Hoi Wan (Samantha Ko). Hoi Wan and Suet Ying both hail from R. Cino Outubro and were once buddies. However, Suet Ying became the other woman and snatched Hoi Wan's boyfriend as she wanted to marry into a wealthy family. Hao In intends to take advantage of Hoi Wan's hatred by turning it into some weapon to attack Hao Kuan and his wife. In a situation where every family member seems to be scheming, Hao Kuan adheres to righteous principles and boldly deals with Hao In's relentless maneuvers.

programme.title: Like Mother, Like Daughter
programme.desc: Public relations queen TONG MAN-LEI (Jinny Ng) raises her Gen Z daughter TONG SUM ( Desta Lee) alone and she is a control freak. MAN-LEI's mother, TONG CHO KA-BING (Stephanie Che), has spent half of her life supporting her husband and raising their children. She is suddenly "awakened" and she returns to Hong Kong from Canada. She decides to reclaim her lost time and she moves into MAN-LEI's home. Many years ago, KA-BING and her daughter completely fell out because MAN-LEI insisted to have her daughter out of wedlock. Now, KA-BING suddenly breaks in without warning and disrupts MAN-LEI's life. MAN-LEI strives to maintain order, while TONG SUM mediates between the two, creating sparks and constant conflicts in this three-generation household. In the workplace, the wealthy heir, “Marketing Guru” YEUNG FAN (Gary Chiu), is parachuted into the company to lock horns with MAN-LEI on equal footing. MAN-LEI's career and family are facing crises at the same time.

programme.title: Scoop 2026
programme.desc: "Scoop" airs from Monday to Sunday, closely following major social events and interesting stories, while also reporting the latest updates in the entertainment industry, celebrity news, as well as drama promotions and behind-the-scenes features. The "Today's Breaking News" segment keeps viewers up to date with the day's hottest stories. The in-depth feature section explores current affairs, social, and livelihood issues that the public cares about, interviewing relevant experts for their insights.

programme.title: Who Heals the Healers?
programme.desc: Doctors have said "You're sick" countless times, but rarely have they heard it said to themselves. The news department's Fang Dongsheng team is out in force again, still searching for the "patient" who least resembles a patient—the doctor. They are usually quick, decisive, and accurate in their actions, accustomed to life and death, but when the roles are reversed, becoming patients or caregivers on the sickbed, they too experience avoidance and anxiety. The gods in the public eye are ultimately just ordinary people. How do doctors who save others save themselves? The new program, "Doctor, Are You Sick?", delves into the difficult reality of doctors' lives, examining their vulnerability and struggles, and revealing the most authentic, flesh-and-blood human stories behind the white coats.

programme.title: Demi-Gods and Semi-Devils (2021)
programme.desc: Mr. Jin Yong created a magnificent martial arts world for readers, and *Demi-Gods and Semi-Devils* is one of the most beloved and sought-after masterpieces in his novel series. Its classic status is self-evident, and it remains a popular subject for adaptation. Set in the Northern Song Dynasty during the reign of Emperor Zhezong, the story follows the adventures, love, and hatred of three characters: Qiao Feng (played by Yang Youning), the leader of the Beggars' Sect; Duan Yu (played by Bai Shu), the prince of Dali; and Xu Zhu (played by Zhang Tianyang), a young monk from Shaolin Temple. It also explores the complex web of martial arts grudges and the inescapable cycle of greed, anger, and delusion, painting a vivid picture of human relationships and symbolizing that all beings in the world are ultimately bound by the painful entanglements brought about by "love."

programme.title: Big City Shop 2026
programme.desc: “Big City Shop” introduces viewers to a wide range of timely topics, including seasonal products, health and wellness, fitness activities, skincare and makeup, fashion apparel, infant care, parenting knowledge, local delicacies, and pet care trends. The content is all-encompassing! In addition to hands-on demonstrations, experiences, or tests by the hosts, experts are invited to share their professional insights. In the cooking segment, several skilled culinary experts take turns showcasing simple and delicious healthy dishes and home-style recipes, helping everyone solve their cooking challenges.

programme.title: Happy Old Buddies
programme.desc: Many people may think that older adults do not have sexual needs, but surveys have shown that this is not the case—older adults often experience less sexual activity due to various reasons. Clinical psychologist Lin Haoming from the Social Welfare Department explains the World Health Organization's definition of sexuality and offers advice for those hoping to rekindle their sex life with their partner. However, if one partner does not wish to resume sexual activity, how should both sides communicate?

programme.title: Just Love
programme.desc: Judge KO HEI MAN (HSUAN JESSICA HESTER) and KOT KWOK KWONG (CHAN KAM HUNG, SUNNY) have agreed that MAN will concentrate on her career while KWONG will be taking care of the housework after they get married. Everything is in harmony until KWONG's father discovers MAN and KWONG's pre-marriage written agreement. Their relationship complicates ever since. To make things worse, KWONG breaks the agreement and demands to have his own career. MAN does not pay much attention at first until she finds out that KWONG, who is free from family burden, is having an affair. MAN learns to become more affectionate in the hope of saving the marriage. Unfortunately, the whole situation deteriorates when KWONG decides that MAN is too close to her ex-boyfriend, TAI CHI HUNG (WANG CHIEH, DAVE), who is now MAN's colleague. Who has the right to decide who should be in charge of earning money instead of running the family?

programme.title: Like Mother, Like Daughter
programme.desc: Public relations queen TONG MAN-LEI (Jinny Ng) raises her Gen Z daughter TONG SUM ( Desta Lee) alone and she is a control freak. MAN-LEI's mother, TONG CHO KA-BING (Stephanie Che), has spent half of her life supporting her husband and raising their children. She is suddenly "awakened" and she returns to Hong Kong from Canada. She decides to reclaim her lost time and she moves into MAN-LEI's home. Many years ago, KA-BING and her daughter completely fell out because MAN-LEI insisted to have her daughter out of wedlock. Now, KA-BING suddenly breaks in without warning and disrupts MAN-LEI's life. MAN-LEI strives to maintain order, while TONG SUM mediates between the two, creating sparks and constant conflicts in this three-generation household. In the workplace, the wealthy heir, “Marketing Guru” YEUNG FAN (Gary Chiu), is parachuted into the company to lock horns with MAN-LEI on equal footing. MAN-LEI's career and family are facing crises at the same time.

programme.title: Hands Up 2026
programme.desc: The brand-new children's program “Hands Up” encourages kids to ask questions bravely, express themselves, and pursue their goals!
